About FMWIF

FMWIF is a global platform dedicated to connecting researchers, innovators, experts and keynote speakers to promote knowledge exchange, research and innovation worldwide.

Founder | Director | Keynote Speaker | Reviewer

Zarqa Zulifqar

Founder | Director | Keynote Speaker | Reviewer

Zarqa Zulifqar is a global keynote speaker and the Founder of Future Minds World Innovative Forum (FMWIF). With a strong research background and a passion for knowledge, innovation and global collaboration, she works to inspire minds and promote the exchange of ideas across the world.
